protocol.signal: causal per-bar options order-flow imbalance z of the OTHER underlying (e62.build_states tox_signal='imbalance', expanding-z-scored), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid (build_cross_section on imbalance states), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward signed log-return mean = sum(log(close_i/close_{i-1})) over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-101
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_imbalance_z_k, own_signed_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset order-flow imbalance -> more positive forward signed return on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
